summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to announce a new Digital Credit Capital Framework. The framework is an internal policy document comprising a USD Reserve policy, revised dividend policy, share repurchase programs, and a BTC monetization program. No specific transaction terms (price, premium, dates, advisors) are disclosed. The filing is a voluntary business update with no binding deal or special situation event. As an internal capital allocation framework, it does not constitute an M&A, tender, or restructuring event.
